script: This is seventeen seconds of phone video. Just me, walking down a hallway. That is all Sam World needs to build a world.

Sam World pulls twenty five frames and sends them to a GPU worker on Modal. It rebuilds the hallway as a one million point cloud, at real scale. Six point eight metres long, two point three metres high.
Next, SAM three point one outlines the objects. Nine of them, doors and doormats, tracked across ten different views. Muse Spark names each one and lifts it into the three D space.
Then you type a world. A haunted Victorian library corridor, lit by candles. Muse turns that sentence into a plan for every wall, the floor, the ceiling, and every object it found.

Muse Image, Meta's image model, paints every surface from that plan. Damask walls, worn oak floors, a smoke stained ceiling. And SAM three D turns the objects SAM found into real three D models, placed back where they stand.

And this is not a picture. You are standing inside the hallway, rebuilt in three D from that one clip. Walk forward, and the haunted library spreads across the real walls. Every door becomes carved mahogany, and every mat a worn Persian rug.
Phone video in. Explorable world out. In the browser, or on a Meta Quest. Sam World. Built with Muse, SAM three point one, SAM three D, and Modal.
